text:
maria: dropping this thread so people can peek before the design sync. idea: add a compact 'silence schedule' strip in the alert preview that visualizes channel-level blackout windows. aim is less vertical real estate and clearer triage context. mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/silence-strip-v1.png

anil: quick a11y callout: timeline must be linear for screen readers and keyboard users. prefer role=list + listitem and aria-posinset. also need non-color cues for overlaps (patterns or icons).

lisa: copy thought: users get thrown off by "silence" vs "mute" vs "suppress". my vote: use "Silence schedule" in headings and a helper line: "Temporarily pause notifications for selected channels." Keep button text as "Edit schedule."

devin: render perf note: if we show a segment per channel it can blow up. suggest grouping by medium (Pager, Email, Slack) and showing stacked mini-segments per group. API can return grouped counts to avoid N+1.
tara: mobile behavior: no hover. show a slim chip like "2 channels silenced" that expands into a sheet with the full timeline and per-channel rows. affordance must be tappable and persistent.
jake: keyboard nav: when the strip receives focus announce "Silence schedule, N items". left/right moves focus between group segments, enter opens the edit modal. roving tabindex works well here. also aria-live polite for changes.
sam: micro-interaction nit: when a system rule creates a silence, badge it with "auto" and tooltip: "Auto-silenced by incident policy X". folks keep asking why notifications disappeared.
maria: visual question: do we show channel chips inline or collapse them under a chevron? collapsing keeps the strip tidy but loses quick context. thoughts?
lisa: prefer collapsed by default with a hover/expander that shows a tiny list on desktop. desktop hover + mobile expand drawer. also ensure the collapsed state shows a count and the top-level mediums.
anil: contrast: current mock uses very light fills that fail AA for 3:1. use stronger fills or borders and include a high-contrast mode toggle. also ensure focus ring meets 3:1 contrast.
devin: API suggestion: preview.silences = [{group:'Pager', start:'2025-04-02T10:00Z', end:'2025-04-02T10:30Z', source:'auto', count:1}] this flattens complexity and avoids extra lookups.
jake: SR phrasing proposal: "Silence schedule strip. X items. Use left and right arrow keys to navigate." Add per-item label like "Pager silenced from 10:00 to 10:30 (auto)".
tara: mobile copy for the pill: "2 channels silenced" and the expanded sheet header: "Silence schedule (2 channels)". CTA: "Edit schedule" and a small explainers line: "Silences stop notifications but do not close incidents."
sam: small UX detail: when multiple groups overlap, show a stacked glyph with a +N to indicate extras rather than shrinking segments too small to tap.
maria: action items: maria -> update mock with collapsed-by-default and hover mini-list; anil -> a11y spec (roles, SR strings, contrast tokens); lisa -> finalize copy strings; devin -> add grouped endpoint proposal; jake -> keyboard nav doc; tara -> mobile sheet flow. I'll upload new art before EOD.
design-bot: mock updated: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/silence-strip-v2.png (uploaded by maria)
maria: thanks all if anyone sees blockers before the sync ping me.
